id./param/scenario/cs/b_120_cs_060.pack|cs_: News of Veronica's death spread through Arboria in an instant.
And Veronica's funeral was held that very day...
"O Yggdrasil, symbol of all life in the world, another young life born in Arboria has fallen...
"May Veronica's soul, one leaf of the twin sages, return to You and bud again as a new leaf.
"Everyone, thank you for gathering today for my sister, Veronica.
"To save all the world's life, she disregarded herself and protected the Luminary to the end.
"Everyone, for the soul called to the World Tree, please offer a lock of hair to the sacred flame.
"Oooh, oooh...!! Veronica, my angel. How could you leave me behind...!
"Veronica... such a parting. It's too cruel, too cruel...
"Serena is steady, but her parents' grief... I can't bear to watch.
"{var:1}... I have something to tell everyone. Please come to the cathedral."
